title: DNA extraction for bacteria
author: Eby Sim
materials: Briefly vortex the Powerbead tube to mix reagents and bacterial biomass.

Assess quality on a Spectrophotometers (NanoDrop TM (Thermofiseher) or equivalent). Key quality metrics are listed below. Samples that do not fall within this value should not be sent for long-read sequencing. While nucleic acid concentration is also measured by the spectrophotometer, it is not a key parameter at this stage. A260/A280: 1.8 - 2.0 A260/A230: 2.0 - 2.22

steps.title: Streak bacteria onto media
steps.instruction: Streak bacteria of interest onto their respective optimum solid media and incubate plates at optimal growth conditions.

steps.title: Verify colony purity
steps.instruction: On the day of DNA extraction, observe the plate to ensure purity; do not attempt extraction if different colony morphologies are observed.

steps.title: Prepare Powerbead tube and add biomass
steps.instruction: Add reagents and transfer biomass into a clean 2 mL Powerbead tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µL Powerbead Solution and 50 µL Solution SL to a clean 2 mL Powerbead tube.
Using a fresh 1 µL inoculation loop, pick up 4 streaks from the first quadrant and dislodge the biomass into the tube.
Using another fresh 1 µL inoculation loop, pick up 4 streaks from the second quadrant and dislodge the biomass into the same tube.

steps.title: Vortex tube
steps.instruction: Affix the Vortex adaptor onto the Vortex‑Genie 2, place Powerbead tubes horizontally with caps facing inward, and vortex at maximum speed for 00:02:00 (for Mycobacterium species vortex for 10 minutes).

steps.title: Centrifuge after vortex
steps.instruction: Remove tubes from the adaptor and centrifuge at 10 000 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to collection tube
steps.instruction: Carefully aspirate 300 µL supernatant without disturbing the pellet or beads, and slowly dispense the entire volume into a 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Add Solution IRS and mix
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Solution IRS, gently finger‑flick the collection tube to mix; if liquid remains on the underside of the lid, give the tube a quick wrist‑flick to collect it.

steps.title: Centrifuge after IRS
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 10 000 × g, room temperature, for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Second supernatant transfer
steps.instruction: Carefully aspirate 300 µL supernatant without disturbing the pellet, slowly dispense into a 2 mL collection tube; no viable cells are expected, but confirm viability when working with high‑containment microorganisms (e.g., Mycobacterium tuberculosis).

steps.title: Add Solution SB and mix
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL Solution SB and gently invert the tube to mix; if liquid sticks to the underside of the lid after mixing, pulse‑centrifuge to collect the liquid.

steps.title: Incubate on ice
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube on ice for 00:06:00.

steps.title: Load DNA onto spin column (first aliquot)
steps.instruction: Slowly aspirate 700 µL of the DNA mixture, dispense into a spin column, and centrifuge at 10 000 × g, room temperature, for 30 seconds; discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Load DNA onto spin column (second aliquot)
steps.instruction: Slowly aspirate the remaining 200 µL, dispense into the same spin column, and centrifuge at 10 000 × g, room temperature, for 30 seconds; discard the flow‑through and replace the collection tube with a new one.

steps.title: Wash with Solution CB
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL Solution CB, centrifuge at 10 000 × g, room temperature, for 30 seconds; discard the flow‑through and replace the collection tube with a new one.

steps.title: Dry spin to remove ethanol
steps.instruction: Perform a dry centrifuge at 10 000 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute to remove residual ethanol; replace the collection tube with a new 1.5 mL Lo‑Bind tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA with Solution EB
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL Solution EB to the centre of the membrane and incubate at room temperature for 00:03:00.

steps.title: Final spin to collect eluate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the spin column at 10 000 × g, room temperature, for 30 seconds; discard the spin column.

steps.title: Quantify DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Assess dsDNA concentration on a fluorometer (Qubit or equivalent); ensure concentration and amount meet the requirements of the sequencing technology. For long‑read sequencing, use the broad‑range assay kit on the Qubit.

steps.title: Assess DNA integrity
steps.instruction: Evaluate dsDNA integrity by 0.6 % (w/v) agarose gel electrophoresis or TapeStation with an appropriate ladder; ensure the majority of fragments are greater than 20 kb.

steps.title: Store extracted DNA
steps.instruction: Store DNA at –80 °C; do not freeze DNA before completing steps 18‑19. Keep DNA at 4 °C until all quality checks are done.
